From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sofia Delgado <sofia@lumenbridge.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 15:10:00 -0700
Subject: Recap + draft mutual plan (post-discovery)

Hi Sofia — great to meet earlier today. Quick recap from our discovery call and a draft mutual plan attached for your review. I captured the milestones we discussed, owner recommendations, and the target close date we tentatively scoped.

Key points:
- Target close: 2026-08-31 (we can shift if procurement requires longer)
- Milestones & owners:
  - Security & legal review (owner: LumenBridge — Carlos)
  - Staging access & test dataset (owner: Redwood — Tessa/Marissa)
  - Pilot integration & throughput test (owner: LumenBridge Eng)
  - Pricing & PO (owner: LumenBridge Procurement)
- Dependencies: SOC 2 summary, procurement T&C redlines, staging access credentials, a short performance test script (we can provide).

Action items for this week (from the draft):
1) LumenBridge: Complete security questionnaire + share procurement timeline (Carlos / Sofia) — due EOD Thu 8/13
2) Redwood: Provide SOC 2 summary and a scoped staging environment for a 2-week pilot (Tessa / Marissa) — due Mon 8/16

I attached LumenBridge_MUTUAL_PLAN_v0.2.xlsx; it’s intentionally lightweight so we can iterate. Please reply with any changes to owners/timelines and whether you want us to move the closing target to mid-September. Happy to hop on a 30-min internal alignment call if helpful.

Thanks again — looking forward to progressing.

—
Tessa Morgan
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference

Date: Thu, 13 Aug 2026 11:23:45 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap + draft mutual plan (post-discovery)

Hi Tessa — thanks for the succinct recap and the draft. Carlos and I reviewed internally; a couple of notes:

1) Procurement will likely push the PO and legal review out to mid-September. Would you be open to moving the target close to 2026-09-15?
2) Our security team requires a completed vendor questionnaire before we can grant staging access — I’m attaching the questionnaire and asking Carlos to own it.
3) We will need a short description of the data handling + retention model and the SOC 2 report summary from your side.

We’ll aim to have the questionnaire back to you by EOD Tue 8/17, but if procurement flags anything else it might slip. If you can send the SOC 2 summary and proposed staging plan by Monday 8/16, that would keep things moving.

Appreciate the flexibility — will confirm dates after Carlos routes the questionnaire.

Best,
Sofia
Head of Programs | LumenBridge
